notes: PdfCraft is Acrobat-shaped, not a ribbon: a tab strip, a mode bar (All tools / Edit / Convert / E-Sign), a left tools panel driven by the tool catalogue, a floating quick bar, and a right rail of panels with page navigation at its foot.

In "ribbon", each entry's "surface" says where it sits: modeTab (a mode-bar tab and its left panel), floatingToolbar, chrome (title bar, tab strip, mode bar), rail, contextualPanel/contextualBar/workspace (shown only in a given state).
Controls with kind "toggle" and a tool command set a QuickTool (a page-interaction mode), as Acrobat tools do.
"availability" marks catalogue items that upstream lists but has not built: planned:<milestone>, provider (optional AI), later.
Every control with source "office" is an Adobe Acrobat Pro feature with no upstream counterpart; its sourceRef is null and its command id is proposed.
